itemUsage.en: Vanguard Operator Matsukiri, supplying you all the info you need to know.
itemUsage.zh: 先锋干员松桐，提供你所需要的一切信息。

itemDesc.en: The only expenses you need to bear are a little time and some trifling fees.
itemDesc.zh: 你要付出的，只不过是一小段时间，和一些微不足道的代价。

description.en: Gradually generates <@ba.vup>{value}</> DP, ATK <@ba.vup>+{makiri_s_2[passive].atk:0%}</>, recovers HP by <@ba.vup>{makiri_s_2[passive].hp_recovery_per_sec_by_max_hp_ratio:0%}</> of Max HP per second; DP cost of all Defender and Supporter Operators in the Deployment Waiting Zone <@ba.vup>{cost_decrease}</>, and Max HP <@ba.vup>+{max_hp:0%}</> (HP increase stacks up to <@ba.vup>{max_stack_cnt}</> times, lasting until the next retreat)
description.zh: 逐渐回复总共<@ba.vup>{value}</>点部署费用，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{makiri_s_2[passive].atk:0%}</>，每秒恢复<@ba.vup>{makiri_s_2[passive].hp_recovery_per_sec_by_max_hp_ratio:0%}</>的最大生命值；技能开启时立即使待部署区所有重装与辅助干员费用<@ba.vup>{cost_decrease}</>，并且最大生命值<@ba.vup>+{max_hp:0%}</>（生命加成最多叠加<@ba.vup>{max_stack_cnt}</>次，持续至下次撤退）
